items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: that's where I attended private school with Jessica Innes at 2622, Jenna Street private school

ctx.x: Nineteen-o-three. Did you live out there alone?

No, I came to New Orleans when I was nine months old. Oh. I was living out at St. Mary in Britannia. And I moved back on Clara in the 4424, Clara between the Poyne Avenue and Jenna. And I moved from there to 4530 South Robinson Street. And from 4530 South Robinson Street, that's where I attended private school with Jessica Innes at 2622, Jenna Street private school. Jessica Innes? Yeah, that was her name. And from there I went to 5318 St. Charles Street, that was New Orleans University, that's where I attended…
